text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from shopping for training equipment
with Hokko Tarumae—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh~ they're holding a raffle.
Reminds me of the lotteries back home...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I've never really won anything like that.
The person running the raffle would always cheer me on, saying, 'You'll get it next time!'...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words reminded me that I had received
a lottery ticket from my shopping earlier.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I see. You got a ticket earlier, right?
I hope you win something!
choice_data_list: ...Tarumae, why don't you give it a spin?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But wasn't that a freebie from
your shopping trip, Trainer?
Wouldn't it be weird for me to use it...?
choice_data_list: What I bought today is something for Hokko Tarumae to use, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: What kind of logic is that...?
choice_data_list: Now is the time to settle our long-standing grudge!
Now is the time to settle our long-standing grudge!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: D-Don't make it sound so bad! It's not like I hold a grudge just because I kept losing!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh* At any rate,
I understand that you desperately
want me to enter the lottery, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Then how about we pull it together?
That way, there shouldn't be any issue
with your logic, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: If we're gonna do this, let's aim for the jackpot!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me! May I draw a raffle ticket?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Hokko Tarumae,
I eagerly cranked the raffle wheel!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Y-You really can win these things, huh.
I'm just a little surprised—
choice_data_list: Feel free to use it whenever you like.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Wait a minute.
Trainer, are you trying to make me
use this ticket all by myself?
choice_data_list: Because Tarumae was the one who won it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Did you already forget our conversation from earlier?
We spun and won this together, so there's no way I could use it all by myself.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "So wouldn't it make the most sense for us to use this ticket?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Good grief—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Still, in practice, the timing is really tricky to get right...
Hmm...—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
If it's alright, could you hold onto
this hot springs trip voucher for me?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...It's a crucial time right now, so
I didn't think it'd be appropriate
to just go off and enjoy a trip.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: So, I'm not sure when it'll be, but once things settle down a bit, let's discuss the timing again.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'd love to use it for something like
an 'Extra-Large Great Job Party'.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh, no way!? Alright!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a huge portion...!
And it looks so delicious, too!
choice_data_list: I can't wait to eat it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Just so you know, Trainer,
you're eating this with me, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Because this is something the two of us
spun the wheel together and won, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Well of course!
Honestly now—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Right! Let's hurry back and eat!
Somehow, I've suddenly gotten super hungry!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of us enjoyed the spoils of victory,
turning them into energy for tomorrow...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
“—This is way more than I expected...!
Finishing all this might be a bit tough for just us—”
choice_data_list: Then want me to share some with you?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...! That's the one!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I'll try contacting Rickey right away!
And Acute-san and Falco-san too—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, we threw a spontaneous carrot party and happily polished it all off together with Hokko Tarumae and her friends...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's correct!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Winning is great and all, but...
it's hard to figure out what to do with just one carrot.
choice_data_list: Why don't you eat it, Tarumae?
Why don't you eat it, Tarumae?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: No way! We won this prize from the raffle we drew together, so there's no way I can use it all by myself!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm.
Maybe I should just cook something with it to use it up.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I just feel like it makes the most sense
for us to eat it together—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Hokko Tarumae and I shared some vegetable soup she had made, warming both body and soul—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I missed...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even though I knew the odds of losing
were obviously much higher,
it's still a little disappointing...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...That being said, these are tissues we won together
in the lottery. Shall we leave them in the Trainer's Room for shared use?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For a while after that, every time Hokko Tarumae saw the tissue box in the trainer's room, she would remember losing and feel disappointed all over again—
